visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An animated sequence begins with a character wearing a yellow hood sleeping under a pink blanket. A white alarm clock on the left vibrates violently. (2) The character reaches out from under the blanket and forcefully slams the alarm clock to stop it. (3) The scene cuts to a pink-haired character with messy buns, looking exhausted with heavy dark circles under her eyes, sitting up in a yellow bed. (4) A close-up reveals her tired face slowly transitioning into a small, mischievous smile. (5) She dives headfirst under the pink blanket, then suddenly propels herself upward while holding a pink pillow against a bright yellow background. (6) The background fills with white and yellow flowers as she looks refreshed and blissful, glowing with golden light. (7) She is then seen performing a full-body stretch on the bed, displaying high energy and a wide grin. (8) She pulls the pink blanket back over her head, settling back into a peaceful sleep. (9) The final phase shows a white promotional screen displaying 16 distinct stickers with various expressions and captions.

(6) The audio concludes with a cheerful, celebratory jingle featuring rhythmic bells and a final percussive 'ding'.
